title: C26 Q10: the probability-distribution layer on the take-out: quantiles of the path (overshoot, wait, MAE, MFE, L1) and a stop x target grid read off them

what.name: Events
what.value_plain: C26 held highs taken out in a DOWN phase (phase1_recent.py), 15m Binance spot BTCUSDT
what.label: OURS

what.name: Layer
what.value_plain: operator's standing probability-distribution layer (research/prob_dist_layer_brief_2026-10-16/BRIEF.md, design D2 'outcome after event'): read what price did off its own quantiles instead of a fixed stop and target
what.label: OURS

what.name: Path
what.value_plain: overshoot above H1 before the first 15m close back under it; bars waited; after that entry close within 96 bars: MAE = highest high above entry, MFE = deepest low under entry, L1 = the pull-back low; all in % of H1
what.label: OURS

what.name: Grid
what.value_plain: short from the entry close; stop = MAE p50 / p75 / p90 and 1.0 %; target = MFE p25 / p50 / p75; else exit at the 24h close; stop checked before target; fee 0.10 % per round trip
what.label: OURS

what.name: Quantiles
what.value_plain: linear interpolation, p25 / p50 / p75 / p90
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10 % per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: phase1_dist_look.py <repo> <cache> --until 2026-11-01T07:45 --card <this file>. The stops and targets are read off the same 30 events they are scored on, so the grid is a shape, not a result: Phase 2 freezes the quantiles on SEEN and scores them once on VALIDATION.
window: RECENT design window 2026-06-21 .. 2026-11-01 (SEEN: looked at here, nothing here is evidence; DEV scores come from phase3_dev.py, card c26-h1-structural-lower-high)

verdict.label: Design look on SEEN, n=30: the stop x target grid is flat, mean net +0.10 to +0.39 %: the drift after the reclaim makes the trade, not the exit shape

why: Every stop x target pair lands in the same narrow band of mean net, so the exit shape is not where the edge would come from.
Half the reclaims come on the take-out bar or the next (wait p50 1 bars) with overshoot p50 0.33 %; the slow tenth (p90) is the Q7 band-overshoot case.
MFE p50 1.50 % against MAE p50 0.71 % is about 2:1 before fees, but L1 p50 1.01 % sits at half the available move, so L1 as target takes the first half.
Right use: freeze stop / target quantiles from SEEN (Phase 2 card), score once on VALIDATION; a grid searched on VALIDATION is the overfit the roadmap forbids.
